info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Telecom Sim Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM Status Retrieval API allows users to efficiently access the current statuses of telecom SIM cards in batch. This endpoint enables developers to obtain comprehensive information regarding the operational state of multiple SIMs, making it essential for telecom service providers and system integrators. Typical use cases include monitoring SIM performance, validating provisioning processes, and managing inventory effectively. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their operational workflows and improve customer service through real-time data access.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of the SIM.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the real-time status of the SIM card. This includes information about connectivity, validity, and other operational parameters, which can help in diagnosing issues or confirming successful activation.
